## Builder 1: what exists now, and what is left

Built (3 commits after the survey): `setLeagueProfile` (contact email, never emptied; city, blank is none; time zone, named only; listing) and `setLeagueAudience` (rule `rules/audience-change.ts`: toward adults asks the R-14 tick, away never asks; an adult league bringing children in clears a confirmed "children in full" through `clearLeagueValueInside` in `clear-setting.ts`, logged as its own clearing). Store `leagueProfile`, `setProfile`, `setAudience`; queries `find-league-profile`, `update-league-profile`, `update-league-audience`. Role rows, isolation cases, activity messages. Screen: `settings-area/profile-panel.tsx` (name, short name with the 12-month forwarding sentence, the four fields, who plays with the tick and the "clears full names" sentence before saving); Archive (asks once, `?archive=ask`) and Un-archive in `publish-panel.tsx`, `runArchive` in `run-publish.ts`; the archived staff notice links to League settings (`shell.archivedNoticeUnarchive`); the contact-email "Must fix" item now points to Profile. Part 1 was already built (survey); nothing added there.

Run and passed: `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:web`, vitest of `packages/core/src/modules/leagues` (353), `role-matrix.test.ts` with it (605), `packages/database/src/isolation` (370), settings-area and staff (with `profile-panel.test.ts`, `runArchive` cases), `fence-filter-check.mjs` on the three new query files (3 caught, 0 problems). Decisions pending: S-95 (decided for you), T-351, T-352. No migration.

Left for builder 2:

- The done test in a browser (`tests/browser/<name>-test.mjs`), on a phone width: league:make on PGlite for an email with no account, that person signs up and is owner, a visitor gets "not found", the owner renames (name and short name) and publishes from the draft notice's link, the visitor sees it, the old address forwards, an admin can publish and archive, a scheduler is refused, each change in the activity log. Pictures (at most six).
- The harmful-text browser test types into every free-text field: the five new Profile fields need to be reached by it (not run by builder 1).
- Profile is drawn AFTER the settings' forms (T-352) because `check-web-shell.mjs` posts settings forms by index; to move it to the top, change those checks to find forms by field name first. No jump link to it yet.
- The spec (T-185): P2 §6 / P4 §6 should describe Profile, who plays and Archive as built; S-95's wording is the source. Step 2.82's "load the demo league" line about confirming privacy choices is not written.
- The settings page's success words after renaming the short name: the redirect goes to the old address, which forwards; check it in the browser.

Distrust: the stand-in's `leagueProfile` makes up the listing (adult leagues listed) and has no city. `runArchive` refusals for a scheduler were checked on the stand-in only. The "toward adults" order youth < mixed < adult is my reading of the line (S-95). Archive in an archived-read-only league: Profile forms are drawn disabled; not seen in a browser.

## Builder 2: what was closed, and what is left

- Profile is the first part of League settings: `check-web-shell.mjs` finds each settings form by the setting its hidden `key` names (`settingFormAction`); T-352 corrected (cost about 6 commands).
- The stand-in keeps a league's profile as the seed made it (`listedByDefault`, a city in each league's facts, the empty league none) and now changes it: name, short name (old one forwarding, `stand-in-league-states.ts`), profile, who plays. Its public pages still draw the cast's name (`stand-in-league-sites.ts`).
- S-95's order checked against R-14 and the plan line, one line per move: youth→mixed asks (adults appear, people of unknown age shown as adults); youth→adult asks (the same, for everyone); mixed→adult asks (the same); adult→mixed never asks and clears a confirmed "children in full" (children come in); adult→youth the same; mixed→youth never asks and keeps it (those children were already covered).
- PRODUCT FAULT FIXED: on a phone the draft notice's link was only in the pill's visually hidden sentence; the strip a phone shows now carries it (out of the tab order, the strip being hidden from screen readers), `staff-frame.tsx`.
- `tests/browser/league-profile-test.mjs` (390×844, scripts off, every wait 60 s): 67 checks pass. Seen to FAIL when broken by hand: toward adults never asking (the no-tick hand-post check), and short names not forwarding (the rename step). Restored; product diff empty.
- `harmful-text-test` types the attack into Profile's name and city and posts it into short name, contact email and time zone (refused): passed, 2160 checks. Page-step row: the settings page shows Profile and the forwarding sentence.
- Spec: P4 §6 Profile and a P2 §6 paragraph after U-14 say what was built.
- Merged `build/stage-1`; after it `npm run check`, `typecheck`, `test:web` (272) and vitest of the folders named were run (see the lead's report).

Left, and distrust:

- `/find` does not exist in the web app, so the listing is checked as saved, not as appearing in the finder.
- Archive keeps the public pages up, as U-9 says ("read-only, still viewable"); the brief's "public pages gone" disagrees with U-9, so U-9 was followed.
